blocks.content: Each instruction in a Dockerfile produces a layer. Docker reuses a cached layer when the instruction and all its inputs are unchanged, and once one layer misses, every layer after it rebuilds.

docker image history nginx:1.27
docker build --progress=plain .   # shows CACHED per step

blocks.title: Order matters more than you think
blocks.content: Copy your lockfile and install dependencies before copying source. Source changes every commit; dependencies rarely do, so this one ordering decision is usually the difference between a 4-second and a 4-minute build.
